_comment: Committed source registry for the incremental recency refresh. Only free, ToS-clean, CI-friendly feeds are enabled. Change-detection is by feed pubDate + HTTP conditional GET; per-industry watermarks live in data/store/<slug>/watermarks.json. Crons are UTC (IST = UTC+5:30).

full_rebuild.note: Weekly, Mon 03:00 UTC (= 08:30 IST). Re-derives the analytical sections via research-industry.mjs, which is itself incremental (cached) and write-if-better.

excluded.reason: Blocks datacenter/cloud IPs (GitHub-hosted runners get 401/403). Prefer BSE for the same disclosures, or route via a residential proxy / self-hosted runner.

Official filings via an unofficial/undocumented API; needs per-company scrip codes + browser UA/Origin headers. Left out of the default recency pass until scrip codes are wired; safe to add per-industry.
ToS forbids scraping; no public API. Use primary sources (BSE/SEBI/AMFI) instead.
No public developer API; scraping restricted.
Explicitly not available programmatically; scraping forbidden.
